integrity: All presented finite checks use exact rational arithmetic and are reproducible from a standalone Python 3 standard-library script. Infinite-size claims rely on the written proof.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted binary bipartite graph, uniformly random full primary removal sequence, secondary extinction only after the last neighbor, no cascade or rewiring. Mean robustness is prior work. Historical priority of exact pairwise covariance is provisional; independent audit not performed.
title: Exact coextinction-rank covariance and a degree-invisible fourfold robustness-variance gap
